# Add a Provider adapter

Runifold 0.10.1 · Audience: contributor.

## Goal

Add a Provider adapter through the canonical runtime contracts.

## Use this API

`ProviderModel + Model; canonical ModelRequest/ModelStreamEvent`

Dependencies / prerequisites (use the same Runifold release family):

- Contributor workspace
- Use the new feature in place of anthropic in validation once implemented

## Minimal example

The following is extracted from [the compiled source](../../../crates/runifold-providers/src/lib.rs).
Excerpts may use imports, fixtures and helper types from that file; use the complete
source for a runnable example. Test-only assertions and mocks are not application setup.

```rust
#[cfg(feature = "anthropic")]
pub mod anthropic;
```

## Production example

Use an existing compatible profile if its protocol already fits. For a native protocol add a feature-gated module alongside anthropic/openai, implement Model and provider identity/capabilities, and project every wire event through canonical model semantics. Update Cargo features, the CI feature matrix and docs/PROVIDERS.md. The excerpt shows the module registration; follow the linked Anthropic implementation for a complete adapter.

## Runtime path

ModelRequest → adapter wire projection → transport → canonical stream accumulator → ModelResponse

Preserve the owning crate's canonical execution and authority checks. The full
source linked above provides the executable context; related contracts explain
production persistence and failure boundaries.

## Do not do this

- Do not add vendor wire types to core or model contracts.
- Do not guess model capabilities or hide retries.
- Do not copy a full transport for another endpoint using the same protocol.

## Diagnostics

- `runifold ai explain RF-AI-FEATURE-001 --json`

## Tests

Run from the Runifold workspace. Check-only examples do not invoke providers.
For a downstream application use its own package/test name after copying the pattern.

```sh
cargo test -p runifold-providers --no-default-features --features anthropic --locked
cargo check -p runifold-providers --no-default-features --locked
```
